ModMetaData.name: Wave Survival Reforged
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing, Justin C (original), Philbro (art)
ModMetaData.description:
A RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7 rebuild of Wave Survival [Game Mode] by Justin C.
The Wave Survival storyteller is a combat run. Random events are off. Raids arrive on a timer, and each wave is a little stronger than the last. Every fourth wave is a siege, sappers, or maddened animals. A supply pod lands at your orbital trade beacon every day.
- First raid after 5 days, then one every 2 days. - Daily steel, wood, stone blocks, silver, components, and medicine. Survival meals when food is low, and the occasional weapon. - Orbital traders still visit. Wanderers can join a small colony. - Wave Survival scenario: 4 colonists, starting weapons, turret research finished. - An alert counts down to the next wave.
Tune every number in Defs/WaveSurvivalConfig.xml. No other mods required.
Original mod by Justin C. Storyteller art by Philbro: http://philbro.deviantart.com/ Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
